senses.gloss: (b. h.; חָלַל) [put outside,] ḥalal, one unfit for priesthood on account of his father’s illegitimate connection (Lev. XXI, 7; 14, sq.).
units: Kidd. 77ᵃ, v. מִקְוֵה; a. e.—Fem. חֲלָלָה the female issue of a priest’s illegitimate connection, or a priest’s wife illegitimately married to him.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 77a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>ח׳ מוזכרת</he>, v. <cite ref="G00467"><he>זָכַר</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲלָלוֹת</he>.
